demo.problem: Bulk buyers receive no incentive to increase order size.
demo.goal: Test quantity tiers with conversion and order-value metrics before a broad release.
demo.payoff: The business can grow basket size while monitoring whether discounts protect margin.

pull_request.title: feat: add tiered quantity discounts
pull_request.body: Adds bulk discount tiers to calculateLineTotal: 3–4 units → 10% off, 5+ units → 15% off. ProductCard shows a discount nudge when the next add would unlock a tier. CartProvider applies discounts to the cart total.
